values.intro.text.001: Offline reader, search engine, and audiobook maker
values.intro.text.002: Search, read, and listen to your documents offline
values.intro.text.003:
Papercut is a desktop and mobile app for importing HTML, EPUB, and
            text-native PDF files, searching indexed personal libraries, reading
            locally, and generating offline audiobooks you can export and carry with you.

values.features.text.002: Papercut works as a loop: import your documents, search across them, read what matters, and make portable audio when listening fits better.
values.features.text.004: Find text across your whole library
values.features.text.005: Search indexed content across hundreds of imported documents without internet or accounts. Exact and broad search help you recover notes, code references, research quotes, and manual sections.
values.features.text.007: Read HTML, EPUB, and PDF files offline
values.features.text.008: Bring your own documents into local HTML, EPUB, and responsive PDF readers. Tune reflowable text with fonts, reading width, and dark mode while PDFs retain their original pages.
values.features.text.010: Keep documents, folders, and audio together
values.features.text.011: Import many files at once, browse covers or lists, organize folders, edit titles, save generated audio, and move selected documents and audiobooks between Papercut devices.
values.audiobooks.text.003: Generate audiobooks from documents in your library
values.audiobooks.text.004:
When reading is not the right mode, Papercut can turn supported
                documents into saved audio on your device. Voice models download
                only when you choose to use audio; after that, generation and
                playback work without internet.
values.audiobooks.text.006: No cloud processing, document upload, or account required.
values.audiobooks.text.008: No subscription, API key, token limit, or per-character bill.
values.audiobooks.text.010: Save audiobook bundles to share, transfer, or bring back into Papercut on another device.
values.audiobooks.text.012: Android supports background and lock-screen playback.
values.audiobooks.text.014: Kokoro provides offline voices for English, Mandarin Chinese, Spanish, French, Hindi, Italian, and Brazilian Portuguese.
values.audiobooks.text.016: Arabic uses separate offline Piper and Supertonic models. SILMA is also available on Linux x64 through an optional runtime download managed by Papercut.
values.audiobooks.text.018: Today, offline models power audiobook generation. Search, import, and reading remain local document tools.
values.privacy.text.003: Your library stays on your device
values.privacy.text.004:
Papercut keeps imported documents, search, reading, and generated
                audio local by default. Network access is limited to actions you
                choose, such as downloading voice models or fetching release files.
values.privacy.text.006: Imported HTML, EPUB, and PDF files remain local.
values.privacy.text.008: Library search runs against local document content.
values.privacy.text.010: Generated audio stays local, and Papercut does not claim ownership of it.
values.privacy.text.012: Used only when you download voice models, releases, or external resources you request.
values.positioning.text.002: Papercut fits personal libraries built from saved documents, books, notes, manuals, and research material. It keeps search, reading, and listening close to the files you already use.
values.positioning-panel.text.001: Who gets the most from Papercut?
values.positioning-panel.text.003: Search API docs, manuals, and saved references offline.
values.positioning-panel.text.005: Keep papers, notes, and long-form sources searchable and listenable.
values.positioning-panel.text.007: Turn reading packets, EPUBs, and text-native PDFs into private study audio.
values.positioning-panel.text.009: Prefer local tools, fewer accounts, and less cloud lock-in.
values.positioning-panel.text.013: No uploads, API keys, subscriptions, or usage meters.
values.positioning-panel.text.015: Create audio from your own documents instead of buying from a catalog.
values.positioning-panel.text.017: Add cross-document search, library transfer, and offline audiobook generation.
values.positioning-panel.text.019: Keep library search, reading, and audiobook generation local instead of uploading documents into chat-first cloud tools.

values.install-notes.text.002: Practical details about offline audio, privacy, supported files, and installing Papercut on each platform.
values.install-notes.text.003: Does Papercut use AI for anything besides audiobooks?
values.install-notes.text.004: Currently, offline models are used for audiobook generation. Reading, import, organization, and search are local document tools.
values.install-notes.text.005: When does Papercut need internet access?
values.install-notes.text.006: Reading and search work offline. Network access is used when you choose to download a voice model, download a release, or open an external resource. If you do not use audiobook generation, voice model downloads are not needed.
values.install-notes.text.007: Why does English audiobook generation use Kokoro?
values.install-notes.text.008: English voices use Kokoro because it currently offers strong quality among fully offline voice models. The goal is natural-sounding audio without cloud processing, subscriptions, API keys, or per-character billing.
values.install-notes.text.009: How does Arabic audiobook support work?
values.install-notes.text.010: Arabic is supported with separate offline models. Piper is the smaller cross-platform option, while SILMA is available on Linux x64 desktop through an optional runtime download.
values.install-notes.text.012: Papercut does not claim ownership of generated audio. You are responsible for rights in the source text, any reference voice or recording used, and how exported audio is shared. Papercut saves audiobook output locally and does not upload it to a service.
values.install-notes.text.013: Can I move or share generated audiobooks?
values.install-notes.text.014: Yes. Saved audiobooks can be exported as Papercut audiobook bundles, then shared, transferred to another device, backed up, or imported back into Papercut later. If you share, publish, sell, or broadcast generated audio, label it as AI-generated and do not use it to impersonate or mislead.
values.install-notes.text.015: Can I clone or reference any voice?
values.install-notes.text.016: No. Reference-voice features should only be used with voices and recordings you have rights or permission to use.
values.install-notes.text.018: Papercut imports HTML, EPUB, and PDF files. PDF search, Find, and audiobook generation require embedded text; image-only PDFs can be viewed when supported but are not searchable because Papercut does not include OCR yet.
values.install-notes.text.020: Papercut is available in English, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, French, Hindi, Italian, and Brazilian Portuguese.
values.install-notes.text.022: Kokoro provides voices for English, Mandarin Chinese, Spanish, French, Hindi, Italian, and Brazilian Portuguese. Arabic uses separate offline Piper and Supertonic models, with SILMA available on Linux x64 through an optional runtime.
